# r4.2

- Speeds up synchronization by scanning the local folder and listing the remote folder concurrently. The remote directory-listing policy remains unchanged; directory read-ahead is not included.
- Requires both inventories to complete successfully and revalidates the local root before planning uploads or deletions. Failure or cancellation stops the other scan and joins the local worker before returning. An outstanding synchronous filesystem call can delay cancellation.
- Preserves comparison, upload, deletion, exclusion and remote handle-limit behavior.

Generated localhost tests cover overlap, local read failure, local worker panic, remote read/close failure and cancellation without unintended remote writes or deletions. Performance depends on folder layout, latency and the server; real-server and long-duration behavior remain unqualified.

Stable release, replacing r4.1 as Latest. Uses the existing application registration, settings and normal updater channel.
